task.title: Rank each sale within its customer
task.statement: Using ROW_NUMBER, return sale_id, customer_id, and row_num for each sale ordered within each customer by sale_id. Return rows ordered by customer_id and sale_id.
expected_evidence: Partition rows by customer and order each partition by sale_id.

hidden_variables.name: repeated_customer
hidden_variables.purpose: Require numbering more than one row in a partition.

private.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY sale_id) AS row_num FROM sales ORDER BY customer_id, sale_id
hints: A window function computes a value across related rows without collapsing them.
Use PARTITION BY to define each customer's window.
Number each partition with ROW_NUMBER and order its rows by sale_id.
private.solution_explanation: ROW_NUMBER assigns a sequence inside each customer partition while preserving one output row per sale.
